title: [AUG-201] Ghost Caption: add [ CP ] / [ AS ] toggles and make CTX n open the compact Copilot window
why_we_need_this:
In Compact Mode with Ghost Caption the user cannot see Meeting Copilot (AUG-197) or Active project session (AUG-199) at all: the Copilot / Assistant frameless windows are only opened by the Dock Strip `[ CP ]` / `[ AS ]` toggles, and Ghost Caption has none. Its only addition is `[ CTX n ]`, which appears only when hints exist and expands August to the full window, leaving Ghost mode. The AUG-195 mockup (scene "Desktop (Compact Mode) · Ghost Caption") shows Caption + Copilot + Assistant side by side, so the feature is effectively missing for Ghost users.

Found by the user testing commit 03c4892. Code facts:
- Toggles exist only in @client/src/components/compact/DockWidgets.tsx (~L100, `cp-panel-toggle`, `window.august?.setCompactPanel`).
- @client/src/components/compact/GhostApp.tsx ~L350/L451 renders only `useCtxBadge()`; `useCtxBadge().show` sends `{kind:'show-copilot'}` (full window).
- Main process already accepts `august:compact-panel` from the ghost sender (@electron/src/main.ts ~L536, `compact.isGhostSender`) and `CompactController.setPanel` works in ghost shape (@electron/src/compact.ts ~L215, placement for `ghosted` ~L650).
- Panel state reaches the ghost via `august:compact-panels` broadcast (main.ts ~L222).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Ghost Caption tools row shows `[ CP ]` and `[ AS ]` toggles (same labels, aria-pressed and accent-when-on styling as Dock Strip), only when `window.august.setCompactPanel` exists (desktop) and an Active session / copilot is available per the same rule the Dock Strip uses.
- [ ] Clicking `[ CP ]` / `[ AS ]` in Ghost Caption shows / hides the Copilot / Assistant frameless window via `setCompactPanel`; the toggle state follows the `august:compact-panels` broadcast (closing a panel with its × un-highlights the toggle).
- [ ] In Ghost Caption, `[ CTX n ]` opens the compact Copilot window (`setCompactPanel('copilot', true)`) instead of expanding to the full window; August stays in Ghost mode. Dock Square / Ghost Coin keep the existing CTX n behaviour.
- [ ] Opened panels are placed per the existing ghosted placement (above the caption), never overlap the caption or each other, and their bounds persist in window-state.json `panels`.
- [ ] Ghost click-through still works: the new buttons are clickable, the rest of the caption stays click-through as before.
- [ ] Ghost Caption width resize (320–760, AUG-187) still fits the tools row at the minimum width without overflow.
- [ ] Checked on Windows (dev Electron) and code paths reviewed for macOS; no new `process.platform` branch.
- [ ] Client tests / typecheck pass (`npm run electron:test`, client build).
important_constraints:
- Mockup reference: @docs/mockups/AUG-195/assistant-overlay.html (DESK.d2 scene) and @docs/mockups/AUG-195/findings.md §6. Angular brutalist style: 0 border-radius; red only for destructive actions.
- Reuse the Dock Strip toggle logic (extract a shared component/hook from DockWidgets.tsx rather than duplicating).
- Do not change Dock Strip, Dock Square, Ghost Coin behaviour.
- Highest-risk shared files: electron/src/main.ts, compact.ts — changes there must be no-op for non-ghost shapes.
- Commit straight to master.
- Related RCA task is created alongside (spec gap analysis).
